About One skill that holds the voice. Wugweb's voice and Vedanshu's voice are one voice, because Vedanshu is the author of Wugweb (owner, 2026-11-16: "wugweb and vedanshu is same"; and on the name: "because it is the same"). Other skills load it when they write. Client voices are separate and stay with each case study. ### 3. Why The voice is written down in six places that do not agree: the owner's pasted persona outline, docs/skills/wugweb-work/PLAN.md section 5, the Sanity Brand voice draft, brand_guidelines/, the 2023 Notion profile pages, and the working rules in Claude memory. One tested source ends that. ### 4. What it captures, and what it must not Captures, only as shown in his own samples: - Vocabulary and phrasing. - Sentence structure, length and cadence. - Formality and punctuation. - Humour and idioms, only if they appear in the samples. - Spoken fillers, only from real transcripts. - Variants by context: quick chat, formal document, spoken answer. Must not: - Guess personality, beliefs or decision style from how he writes. - Copy typos or inconsistent spelling. Clean up, keep the intended voice. - State a tentative observation as a confirmed preference. Every rule is labelled confirmed (he said it or approved it) or observed (seen in samples, count given). ### 5. Format rules (sizes, counts, layout) live in wugweb-work; this skill owns only how each form should sound. Inherited from the closed social planning session. A bylined or first-person piece uses "I", studio copy uses "we", one per piece, and the voice rules are the same for both. Whether that is one fixed rule or his call per piece is open question 8. "Voice checked against wugweb-voice" is the approval step before any post. The check is: 1. No banned or filler words (words.md). 2. No em or en dashes; British spelling; sentence case. 3. Every number, quote and fact traces to a source. Anything untraced is flagged, not rewritten. 4. The piece matches its mode in modes.md. 5. Client quotes and on-screen terms are unchanged. 6. Result: pass, or a list of flags with proposed wording, plus a confidence level. The check proposes; it does not publish or edit the piece itself. ### 8. How the skill stays portable: - SKILL.md stands alone. The reference files add depth, not anything the core depends on. - Standing rules travel as a marked copy. The owner's standing rules live in docs/skills/STANDING-RULES.md and nowhere else. A tool that cannot open a second file still needs the three writing rules and "nothing invented", so SKILL.md and the export carry them as a copy, labelled as copied from that file and never edited in the skill. This sits between two of his rules (one home per rule; usable beyond Claude).
